feeds.title: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
feeds.description: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is a worldwide faith of over 16 million members centered on the belief that everyone on earth is a son or daughter of a loving God1 and that His Son, Jesus Christ, saved the world from sin and death. The mission of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is to help all of God's children come to Jesus Christ3 through learning about His gospel, making and keeping promises with God (covenants), and practicing Christlike love and service.

feeds.title: Meridian Magazine
feeds.description: Meridian Magazine is the place where LDS gather online. Meridian is a values-based publication, drawing upon the beliefs and teachings of the LDS Church.

feeds.title: LDS Daily
feeds.description: LDS Daily was founded in November 2014 to provide both members and non-members with trending news and information about the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and the culture that surrounds it. From breaking news stories and personal stories to fun quizzes, LDS entertainment, and recipes, we strive to share those things we believe matter most.

feeds.title: By Common Consent
feeds.description: By Common Consent (or BCC) was started in 2004 by a group of Mormons to provide a thoughtful, enjoyable, and reasonable place to post and discuss Mormon topics. Over time, we have added new contributors who share this vision. We seek truth, reason, and honesty with our perspectives on faith.

feeds.title: Family Locket Blog
feeds.description: We are a Mormon mother/daughter team sharing ideas for finding ancestors and keeping them close to the heart.

feeds.title: LDS Church Growth
feeds.description: My interest in researching the growth of the LDS Church began in 2002. I began this blog in late 2007 to provide a forum to discuss LDS growth developments and share information.

feeds.title: Called to Share
feeds.description: Hello World! I'm Ben Arkell and the picture above is of my beautiful family. They are definitely my greatest accomplishment. Mormon Light seeks to bring inspiration and uplifting stories to you every day.

feeds.title: Times & Seasons
feeds.description: Times and Seasons has been the premier source for Mormon blogging since its inception late 2003. Times and Seasons is a place to gather and discuss ideas of interest to faithful Latter-day Saints.

feeds.title: Mormon Life Hacker
feeds.description: Mormon Life Hacker gives Tips, tricks, tutorials and more on how to make Mormon (LDS) life easier, simpler, and more enjoyable. IT also helps Mormons simplify their life and focus on what's most important.

feeds.title: This Week in Mormons
feeds.description: Founded at the start of 2010, This Week in Mormons has been a leader in podcasts, blogs, humor, and commentary relevant to the Mormon (Latter-day Saint) community. We tend to take a jovial and somewhat irreverent stance when it comes to dealing with the many issues that face Mormonism today.

feeds.title: From the Desk
feeds.description: From the Desk: Learning by Study and Faith is a history and religion blog. While the site has increasingly become devoted to the history and theology of Joseph Smith and the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, it also provides extensive coverage of wider topics such as American history and ancient history.

feeds.title: Historic LDS Architecture
feeds.description: Welcome to the Historic LDS Architecture blog! This blog studies significant architecture in the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (also known as the LDS or Mormon Church). This includes temples, tabernacles, meetinghouses, and other buildings.

feeds.title: Scriptorium Blogorium
feeds.description: Sharing scripture insights, discussion, expansion, and so on about Mormonism.

feeds.title: Pure Mormonism
feeds.description: Free Agency, Christ Consciousness, Unconditional Love, And Other Forgotten Teachings of the Restoration

feeds.title: Scripture Notes Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about finding Hebrew & Greek meanings, searching the scriptures in more powerful ways than ever before, and storing all the inspiration that comes to you. The mission is to make the study of the scriptures so engaging and insightful, that people spend more quantity and quality time searching them.

feeds.title: Mormon Momma
feeds.description: LDS women discuss church doctrine, policy, and practice as well as current events, life issues, children, families, and whatever else comes to mind.

feeds.title: Juvenile Instructor
feeds.description: At The Juvenile Instructor, we seek to situate the study of Mormonism within wider frameworks, including American religious history, western history, gender history, and, on occasion, the history of the Republic of South Africa.

feeds.title: Segullah
feeds.description: Segullah is a literary journal and blog designed to encourage literary and artistic talent, provoke thought and promote greater understanding and faith among Latter-day Saint women. Mormon women publish insightful writings and images which explore life's richness and complexity while reflecting faithfulness to the gospel of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Zelophehad's Daughters
feeds.description: A Mormon Blog.

feeds.title: Vozes Mórmons
feeds.description: The Brazilian Association of Mormon Studies has as mission to encourage, promote and disseminate academic studies and artistic expressions about Mormonism in Brazil. It fulfills its mission by fostering Mormon studies, by encouraging the production of knowledge by which the Mormon tradition can be read, debated, interpreted, and analyzed in an open, honest, and diverse manner.

feeds.title: A Motley Vision
feeds.description: A Motley Vision is a group blog devoted to exploring the world of Mormon arts and culture. Or to be more specific: Mormon literature, criticism, publishing and marketing.

feeds.title: LDS Women Project
feeds.description: LDS Women Project is a continuously expanding digital library of interviews with Latter-day Saint women from around the world.

feeds.title: Life Outside The Book of Mormon Belt
feeds.description: Life Outside the Book of Mormon Belt is about the experience of being a believing Latter-day Saint, living on the cultural edge of Mormonism.

feeds.title: Seeking YHWH
feeds.description: I believe that Jesus is our Savior. That He called Joseph Smith to translate the Book of Mormon from an ancient record written by ancient prophets. I grew up in the LDS / Brighamite church but after I found out that the LDS / Brighamite church changes doctrines despite the fact they say they don't, God told me to remove my name from their records.

feeds.title: Today in Mormon History
feeds.description: Daily Snippets of what happened on this day in Mormon Church History.

feeds.title: Warfare and the Book of Mormon
feeds.description: This is where I publish my preliminary research notes and ideas concerning warfare in the Book of Mormon. This is a spot for civilians, military historians, members of the LDS church and anybody else who enjoys studying the military aspects of the Book of Mormon and its impact on the LDS Church, society and the field of military history.

feeds.title: LDS Science Review
feeds.description: A Mormon Blog.

feeds.title: Boap.org's Blog
feeds.description: You will find things here that have something to do with Joseph Smith.

feeds.title: Josiah Reckons
feeds.description: Latter-Day Saint thoughts to be reckoned with. Seriously engaging with my faith involves an intellectual element, a pursuit of wisdom, a wrestle with God. When I read the best books of wisdom and liken them unto us, I find insights, meaning, and purpose, I find answers and questions, and I find ways to bless others. I want to share the sum of my thoughts, what I reckon, with you.

feeds.title: Latter-day Saint FAIR-Cast
feeds.description: Winner of the People's Choice Podcast Award for Best Podcast in the Religion Inspiration category. FAIR is a non-profit organization dedicated to providing well-documented answers to criticisms of Latter-day Saint doctrine, belief and practice. Questions or comments about the podcast can be sent to podcast@fairlatterdaysaints.org. Or join the conversation at www.fairlatterdaysaints.org/blog.

feeds.title: MormonLeaks
feeds.description: MormonLeaks is a non profit media organization founded on the belief that increased transparency within the Mormon Church results in fewer untruths, less corruption, and less abuse within Mormonism.

feeds.title: Temple House Gallery
feeds.description: Nauvoo News & Events features stories shared from members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints around the world.

feeds.title: Mormanity
feeds.description: Jeff Lindsay is an LDS guy in Shanghai. Formerly of Appleton, WI, Jeff writes about the Mormon experience, life in China, and the joys of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. Discussions of Mormons and Mormon life, Book of Mormon issues and evidences, and other Latter-day Saint (LDS) topics.

feeds.title: Book of Mormon Wars
feeds.description: This is a friendly discussion among brothers and sisters who all love the Book of Mormon and believe it is actual history. We seek unity on how to interpret the text and Church history. This blog focuses on the North American setting as the simplest and best explanation of Book of Mormon geography, with Cumorah in New York, but we recognize other settings are meaningful for other people.

feeds.title: Latter-day Saint Musicians
feeds.description: The Latter-day Saint Musicians website was designed with you, the music enthusiast, in mind. We are sure that you will find our website to be both informative and entertaining. We feature many different music artists, with many diverse interests and music genres. So, there is something here for everyone - from the younger generation to the older generation

feeds.title: A Thoughtful Faith
feeds.description: A Thoughtful Faith features the stories and perspectives of thoughtful Mormons and other religious thinkers who have something to say about the common challenges and issues facing those who are seeking to live a life of faith within Mormonism and beyond.

feeds.title: Young Mormon Feminists
feeds.description: We are young Mormon feminists advocating for change. Our vision for the future of the feminist movement is that it will be made up of people of all sexes and genders.

feeds.title: LDS Blogs
feeds.description: Welcome to LDS Blogs! This venue has been created by the More Good Foundation, as an online community of everyday, faithful Mormons sharing their lives, hopes, aspirations, challenges, and circumstances as they are influenced by and infused with the gospel of Jesus Christ. This site tries to show what Mormonism looks like from the inside when you live it everyday.

feeds.title: The Millennial Star
feeds.description: The Millennial Star is an LDS Blog. If there is anything virtuous, lovely, or of good report or praiseworthy, we seek after these things.

feeds.title: FAITH-PROMOTING RUMOR
feeds.description: exploring mormon culture, thought and texts

feeds.title: Feminist Mormon Housewives
feeds.description: A safe place to be feminist and faithful. Angry Activists with Diapers to Change.

feeds.title: Mormon Bandwagon
feeds.description: Mormon Bandwagon strives to be a place to safely share alternative perspectives regarding the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints. The LDS/Mormon church encourages its members to confidently profess a sure knowledge of the correctness of the church's truth claims, such as the historical accuracy of the Book of Mormon.

feeds.title: Relief Society Women Blog
feeds.description: A place to learn about the history, purpose, and destiny of the Relief Society in the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints To know the history, purpose, and destiny of the Relief Society.

feeds.title: Becoming LDS
feeds.description: My hope is that through 'Becoming LDS' members of the Church and those trying to learn more about The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints can find ways to BECOME better.

feeds.title: Latter-day Commentary Last Days Signs of the Times
feeds.description: Mormon doctrine, culture and social commentary.

feeds.title: Latter-day Soprano
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Holly the Latter-day Soprano. Welcome to my blog. It's been a labor of love and my 'happy place' to share my music and thoughts about life which are usually positive, hopefully interesting, sometimes motivational, and often entertaining.

feeds.title: MormonPress
feeds.description: The MormonPress blogging team is made up of people who believe strongly in careful research and standing up for their beliefs, religious as well as political. This is a blog about morality in the broadest sense. We write about values and ideals. We take our cues from our best interpretations of the Jesus Christ that we strive to emulate as Mormons.

feeds.title: Falling Away - The Many Reasons Why
feeds.description: This blog is about some of the struggles my children have gone through within The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints. It is titled falling away and so far my children have not 'left' the church, but I can see why some people do and/or they decrease activity. Having a testimony helps get you through struggles, but the more struggles you go through can cause you to question what you think you know or how you feel.

feeds.title: Expert Textperts
feeds.description: Expert Textperts is a blog started by three Mormon guys and and an equally Mormon girl for the purposes of writing about whatever we feel like writing about.

feeds.title: Un Estudio Del Libro De Mormón
feeds.description: A personal study of the scriptures, made by a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

feeds.title: The Mormon Tabernacle Enquirer
feeds.description: This blog is based on the premise that, as in many homes, if you are not teased, you are not loved. Those who create content for this blog love the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, and the culture around that church.

feeds.title: Small and Simple
feeds.description: My name is Eric Nielson. I am a lifelong member of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints. Small and Simple is an LDS Blog with Observations about Mormon Doctrine and Culture.

feeds.title: A Study of the Book of Mormon
feeds.description: A personal study of the Book of Mormon by Brent Leavitt, a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

feeds.title: Amateur Mormon Historian
feeds.description: A blog about the history of the Mormon Church and the Latter day Saint experience in Tennessee.

feeds.title: Ploni Almoni
feeds.description: A Mormon Blog.

feeds.title: Jason's Voyage Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jason Harris, a Neuro-Ophthalmologist, Dad, and Husband. I share aspects of my journey in and later out of Mormonism on this blog.

feeds.title: Latter-day Conservative Blog
feeds.description: The purpose of LatterdayConservative.com is to provide educational resources that promote Liberty based on the Gospel of Jesus Christ. On this website you will find many quotes, articles, videos and downloads featuring teachings of latter-day prophets and other prominent Latter-day Saints.

feeds.title: The Perfect Day
feeds.description: The Perfect Day is dedicated to helping you prepare for an audience with the Savior - the central theme of the Book of Mormon and Temple narrative.

feeds.title: Mormon Mom Planner
feeds.description: If you are looking for a mom planner or mom agenda that is designed to be both cute and functional you have finally found what you are looking for. The mom planner includes both a monthly planner and a weekly planner. We offer the Mormon Mom Planner and the Mom-on-the-go planner, with the same great look and function but without the specific LDS elements.

feeds.title: No More Strangers: LGBT Mormon Forum
feeds.description: No More Strangers: LGBT Mormon Forum is a blog by and about lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender Mormons, and our family and allies in and around the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

feeds.title: FAIR Blog
feeds.description: FairMormon is a non-profit organization dedicated to providing well-documented answers to criticisms of LDS (Mormon) doctrine, beliefs, and practices. We also aim to provide materials to strengthen faith and understanding of the gospel through education.

feeds.title: Exponent II Blog
feeds.description: The purpose of Exponent II is to provide a forum for Mormon women to share their life experiences in an atmosphere of trust and acceptance. This exchange allows us to better understand each other and shape the direction of our lives. Our common bond is our connection to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and our commitment to women.

feeds.title: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
feeds.description: The official Newsroom site of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in United Kingdom.

feeds.title: Dawning of a Brighter Day
feeds.description: The Association for Mormon Letters (AML) is a nonprofit founded in 1976 to 'foster scholarly and creative work in Mormon letters and to promote fellowship among scholars and writers of Mormon literature.'

feeds.title: Tabernacle Choir
feeds.description: The Tabernacle Choir is dedicated to the universal language of music that has the power to bring joy, peace, and healing to its listeners. The Choir, the Orchestra at Temple Square, and the Bells on Temple Square act as goodwill ambassadors for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

feeds.title: Latter-day Saint Mission Prep
feeds.description: Hello. My name is Jimmy Smith. I am a member of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, also called the LDS or Mormon Church. Mormon Mission Prep is a website to learn how to become an effective LDS missionary. Get answers to questions and tips on preparing both physically and spiritually for missionary work.

feeds.title: Cwic Media Blog
feeds.description: Social Issues, Theology, History, No fluff. LDS, Mormon.

feeds.title: Rational Faiths
feeds.description: Three brothers started a blog to discuss openly topics of faith and our Mormon heritage in a well thought out and well researched manner. Here they hope to provide a safe, fair, and balanced space to discuss the complexities, difficulties, and beauty of their Mormon tradition.

feeds.title: Mormon Matters Blog
feeds.description: Mormon Matters is a weekly podcast exploring Mormon current events, pop culture, politics and spirituality. Before its shift to primarily being devoted to a podcast, Mormon Matters has its origins as a large group blog about Mormon topics, and these discussions can still be found in this site's history.
